menu:6058730:1.text: Quiet! Don't scare the fish away!
menu:6058730:1.source_cn: 嘘，小声点，别打扰我钓鱼！

say:1:1322534001:1.text: The guards have been working non-stop lately, so I was thinking of treating them to something special.
say:1:1322534001:1.source_cn: 侍卫们已经连续工作许久了，我总想着弄点好吃的慰劳一下大家。
say:1:1322534001:1.male: The guards have been working non-stop lately, so I was thinking of treating them to something special.
say:1:1322534001:1.female: The guards have been working non-stop lately, so I was thinking of treating them to something special.

say:2:1322534002:1.text: I remember when they'd go fishing on their days off. The fish they caught always tasted better than what you buy at the market... it's been a while since we had a good fried fish.
say:2:1322534002:1.source_cn: 我记得以前侍卫们在假日里会一起约着钓鱼，钓上来的鱼比市...
say:2:1322534002:1.male: I remember when they'd go fishing on their days off. The fish they caught always tasted better than what you buy at the market... it's been a while since we had a good fried fish.
say:2:1322534002:1.female: I remember when they'd go fishing on their days off. The fish they caught always tasted better than what you buy at the market... it's been a while since we had a good fried fish.

say:3:1322534003:1.text: Magister, if you have a moment, could you catch a few fish for the guards? Consider it a personal request... I've been missing those days.
say:3:1322534003:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，如果您有空的话，能为侍卫们钓几条鱼吗？就算...
say:3:1322534003:1.male: Magister, if you have a moment, could you catch a few fish for the guards? Consider it a personal request... I've been missing those days.
say:3:1322534003:1.female: Magister, if you have a moment, could you catch a few fish for the guards? Consider it a personal request... I've been missing those days.

say:0:1322535001:0.text: Wow, look at all these fish!
say:0:1322535001:0.source_cn: 好多鱼！满满看到了鱼了！

say:1:1322536001:1.text: Maybe Chippy spoke too soon... but Magister, these fish don't look big enough.
say:1:1322536001:1.source_cn: 主人，可能满满有点多嘴，感觉这鱼还是不够大？
say:1:1322536001:1.male: Maybe Chippy spoke too soon... but Magister, these fish don't look big enough.
say:1:1322536001:1.female: Maybe Chippy spoke too soon... but Magister, these fish don't look big enough.

say:2:1322536002:1.text: Could be the wrong fishing spot. Maybe we should ask around for a better one.
say:2:1322536002:1.source_cn: 是不是咱们钓点找错了，要不咱问问周围钓鱼的人吧。

say:1:1322537001:0.text: A spot with bigger fish? Oh, of course, it's always the spot's fault when you can't catch anything, right? Heh, typical.
say:1:1322537001:0.source_cn: 鱼又大又多的钓点？哦……我总能遇上你们这样的，鱼不多不...

say:2:1322537002:0.text: But seriously, the quieter spots usually have the bigger fish. I've heard the Floral Ruins is a nice spot. The fish there are huge!
say:2:1322537002:0.source_cn: 不过人越少去的地方鱼越大嘛，我听说遗迹花海那边倒是不错...

say:3:1322537003:0.text: It's a bit of a trek, though, so stay safe on the way there.
say:3:1322537003:0.source_cn: 不过路途遥远，你们要过去的话路上可要注意安全啊。

say:0:1322538001:0.text: This has to be it! The Floral Ruins!
say:0:1322538001:0.source_cn: 遗迹花海的钓点！应该就是这里了！

say:0:1322539001:0.text: Look at the size of these fish! We're definitely at the right spot!
say:0:1322539001:0.source_cn: 好大的鱼！肥美的鱼！这下应该没问题了！

say:1:1322539002:0.text: The guards are in for a big treat! Chippy is getting hungry just looking at these!

say:1:1322540001:1.text: I can't believe my eyes. The guards have never caught anything this big.
say:1:1322540001:1.source_cn: 有些难以置信，侍卫们从来没钓上来过这么肥美的鱼。
say:1:1322540001:1.male: I can't believe my eyes. The guards have never caught anything this big.
say:1:1322540001:1.female: I can't believe my eyes. The guards have never caught anything this big.

say:2:1322540002:1.text: They haven't had a decent meal in ages. They're gonna love this.
say:2:1322540002:1.source_cn: 侍卫们好久没有好好吃一顿了，相信他们见到这些鱼也会很高兴。
say:2:1322540002:1.male: They haven't had a decent meal in ages. They're gonna love this.
say:2:1322540002:1.female: They haven't had a decent meal in ages. They're gonna love this.
